headline: Senior Vessel Planner - Ship Planning, Stowage & Alliance Coordination
summary: Senior vessel planner with a seagoing deck-officer background, equally at home with what a service needs commercially and what the ship can safely execute. Reads every plan from the vessel's side first - how it lands on the master, the chief officer, the terminal and the live operation - and checks the full picture (intake, allocation, stability and stress, DG and special cargo) before committing rather than only chasing space. Calm and decisive under planning pressure, multilingual, confident working with masters, chief officers, port captains, terminals, agents, commercial teams and partner lines, and ready to step up into wider ship planning, service coordination and alliance operations across Europe and head-office teams.
skills: Bay/tier stowage planning, load and discharge sequencing
Stability & stress: GM/GOM, trim vs consumption, shear force, torsion, free-surface effect
DG/IMDG, OOG/BBK, reefer, ISO tank and heavy/high-value cargo planning
Restow management, COD requests, multi-POD calls, phase-in/phase-out
Stakeholder coordination: masters, chief officers, port captains, terminals, agents, commercial teams
Bridge resource management and navigational watchkeeping
Multilingual: English, Persian/Farsi (native), Turkish, Italian, Arabic, Mandarin (learning)

work_history.title: Senior Vessel Planner
highlights: Build, review and adjust container vessel stowage plans for international liner services, balancing vessel safety, commercial priority, terminal execution and schedule reliability.

Set precise per-port allocation from provisional bookings through a self-built, formula-driven Excel system, now adopted as the standard intake and allocation reference across the North America services.
Review intake, TEU/MT utilisation, 20ft/40ft mix, stack weights and bay/tier restrictions before committing each plan.
Plan DG/IMDG, OOG and breakbulk, heavy 20s, reefers, ISO tanks and empties to full segregation, access and safety requirements.
Apply stability and stress judgement across GM/GOM, trim, shear force, torsion, free-surface effect and lashing limits, advising masters on required adjustments.

Manage restows, COD requests, multi-POD calls, partner-allocation issues and phase-in/phase-out constraints on long-haul services spanning the Middle East, Indian Subcontinent, Colombo, North America and Mexico.
Oversee bunker-party operations with active monitoring, notably on LNG vessels, keeping the safety zone clear of DG and reefer units.
Guide colleagues on intake checks, port restrictions, vessel definitions, cargo segregation and restow exposure.
